The same thing happened with progressive turning into handbag house in the late 90's, trance becoming superstardj garbage (remember fucking adaggio for strings?),...

The term first came about in the War of 1812 in America. It also became common during the Bush administration. That's... interesting... am I reading this right that they will stop promoting the reference bitcoin implementation if the core devs go ahead with the blocksize increase?

Not quite. This policy is not specifically related to the blocksize increase debate.

Bitcoin.org will stop promoting the reference bitcoin implementation IF those developers decide to create a hard fork of the bitcoin blockchain which is contentious, i.e. lacking consensus. However, the reference implementation is not currently proposing any contentious hard forks, so the policy has no impact on Bitcoin Core at this time. However, an alternate implementation, Bitcoin XT, is considering an update which could potentially cause a fork in the blockchain at some point in the future. This has been highly contentious, and as a result of this policy, Bitcoin XT will not be promoted on bitcoin.org if such an update is released.
